resent date

  • CURIE: gmeow:resentDate
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/resentDate
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email

The RFC 5322 Resent-Date header value of a message. Non-functional: a message may carry multiple Resent-Date values if it was resent multiple times. The raw header value remains on gmeow:MessageHeader (Principle 4).

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:EmailMessage -> xsd:dateTime

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:resentDate from gmeow:EmailMessage to xsd:dateTime when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:EmailMessage
